title: Kayak Hotel Reviews Scraper
description: Collect Kayak hotel review summaries with scores, positive and negative comments, review source, author, and date label. Batch hotel IDs and sort guest feedback.

batch.title: KAYAK hotel IDs
batch.description: KAYAK hotel identifiers whose public guest reviews you want to collect.
batch.valueDescription: Hotel Id used to run this search.

schema.description: KAYAK hotel identifier used to retrieve property rates or reviews.
Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: recent, highest, lowest.

results.positiveComment: Comfortable room and convenient access to the city.
results.negativeComment: The lobby was crowded in the afternoon.
results.author: Casey Morgan

storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Kayak hotel reviews by hotel ID. Export guest scores, rating labels, comments, source sites, and dates to compare feedback across properties.
storeCopy.intro: Collect Kayak hotel review summaries with scores, rating labels, positive and negative comments, source sites, and date labels. Batch hotel IDs to compare guest feedback.
useCases: Hotel analysts can compare public review scores across competing properties.
Travel researchers can track review themes and source coverage by hotel.
Hospitality teams can monitor feedback patterns for selected destinations.
howToUse: Add a KAYAK hotel ID to each entry in `hotels`.
Choose a review sort order and requested amount.
Set `maxResults` to cap the saved review rows.

faqs.question: Does this return full reviews from every source?
faqs.answer: KAYAK may provide review excerpts and source links. Available text and fields depend on each source response.
